method: Explicit fixtures place source at4, cave at8, Boss at10; opening60HP/60spirit stones and normal ten-card starter. Two roles,12seeds per route. No heals/refills/injected cards/forced kills; one final reward for dual battle. Standard chapter post-victory heal is included in final HP. Policy reads internal intent as an oracle regression baseline; NOT natural full-route or human-difficulty evidence. No numerical reward changes made to force parity.
